data.hook: A tennis-inspired all-court paddle designed with Andre Agassi.
why: Tapered, tennis-style shape for faster swing speed
Sweet spot extended into the upper edges for forgiveness
Honeycomb Propulsion core with Hyper-Foam edge wall
Tech Flex Power for extra pop and consistency
Textured carbon face for spin and control
data.playStyle: Players from tennis who like a longer, racquet-like feel and two-handed backhands.
data.summary: The JOOLA Agassi Pro is part of JOOLA's line with tennis legends Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf. Its tapered shape, inspired by Agassi's racquets, speeds up your swing, and the sweet spot reaches into the upper edges.
data.description:
If you come from tennis, this paddle will feel familiar. The longer, tapered head and 5.5" handle give a racquet-like swing and room for two-handed backhands.

Under the textured carbon face, a 16 mm Propulsion core and Hyper-Foam edge wall cushion contact and extend the sweet spot, while Tech Flex adds power and consistency.

tech.name: Agassi paddle shape
tech.text: Tapered head inspired by Agassi's racquets, with the sweet spot extended into the upper edges.

tech.name: Propulsion Core
tech.text: 16 mm honeycomb that cushions, rebounds for power and extends dwell time.

tech.name: Hyper-Foam Edge Wall
tech.text: Adds cushioning and an edge-to-edge sweet spot.

tech.name: Tech Flex – Power
tech.text: Foam outside the frame for a wider sweet spot and extra flex.

tech.name: Textured carbon face
tech.text: Grips the ball for spin and helps keep dinks low.

faq.q: Who is the Agassi Pro for?
faq.a: All-court players, especially those coming from tennis.
Yes, USA Pickleball and UPA-A approved.

faq.q: How is it different from the Perseus?
faq.a: The Agassi has a more tapered, tennis-like head. The Perseus is squarer at the top.

data.clubTake: Brand new, unused. Our pick for tennis converts. Try it side by side with the Perseus.
